source: Yaci Store analytics (https://yaci-playground.cf-app.org/mcp); identifiers from https://github.com/cardanowall/label-309
query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM transaction_metadata WHERE date in <year window> AND CAST(label AS VARCHAR) IN ('309')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
